title: SeqCst versus Acquire Release
prompt: When should you choose `Ordering::SeqCst` over `Ordering::Acquire` and `Ordering::Release`?
answer: Use `SeqCst` when you need a single globally consistent order of atomic operations across all threads. Acquire and Release only synchronize memory operations between pairs of threads. `SeqCst` prevents store-load reordering across multiple atomic variables, but incurs higher hardware cost on weak memory platforms.
